summary.text: Matt Leber is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 41, which covers Charleston, Colleton and Dorchester Counties.
He previously served in the S.C. House of Representatives from 2023 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Leber was born on April 5, 1973, in Washington, North Carolina.
His official page lists an A.S. from Mitchell Community College in 2003 and military service in the U.S. Army from 1991 to 1998.
He worked as a federal government employee from 2003 to 2012.
He served in the S.C. House from 2023 to 2024 and chaired the freshman caucus in 2022, according to his page.
His Senate committees are Banking and Insurance, Corrections and Penology, Judiciary, Labor, Commerce and Industry, and Medical Affairs.
